scope: Pose-only finger repair using the user-approved source-relative palm-width closure on all ordinary two-bone fingers. The closure converges each finger toward its authored palm plane; thumb opposition and any authored third phalanx retain their dedicated paths. The two original 2099 claw meshes retain eased 65-degree distal flexion. Source hierarchy, bind, weights, proportions and materials retained. All suits have full offline regressions; native visual review is representative, not every suit. Native evidence is capped at two images per representative; a crop pair shows one pose, while runs without a crop show the two requested gameplay frames. No exhaustive finger/palm contact or all-catalogue acceptance is claimed.
